a.text: What is the nature of Originium Arts?
The Spire Casters of Leithanien and the academicians of Columbia each developed their own separate theories.
Of course, both are simply packaging for the benefit of their respective adherents. Regardless of any differences in terminology, the two theories describe the same relationships.
Originium Arts involve the caster exerting influence on external matter through a medium, i.e., an Arts Unit.
The Arts Unit receives and encodes the caster's neural activity, releasing it as energy that interacts with matter or its component particles, resulting in the desired effect.
Modern Arts Units are the product of advances in both theory and industry, with complex energy conversion circuits at their core. Clearly, not all Originium products are suited for this purpose.
However, we cannot ignore how the Infected are able to use Arts without an Arts Unit, using their infected organs to similar effect.
We've all heard the terrifying rumors of Leithanian Spire Casters using one or more Infected as a medium for casting, in effect turning them into massive energy conversion circuits.
Of course, such blatant ethical violations would never be allowed in Columbia.
What about safe, artificial implants that could serve the same purpose, though?

Just as those who've lost their legs in accidents can walk again with prosthetics, or those born blind can see with cornea transplants, those without the ability to use Originium Arts may, one day, harness the same power.
I'm seeing some shocked faces in the audience. Let me emphasize that this is all hypothetical for now.
But I was invited here today by my alma mater to talk about the research that our institute is currently conducting.
And ever since I was student, I've wanted to do more for Columbia using Originium Arts, for everyone in this rapidly evolving society.
Leithanien distributes social resources according to Originium Arts Assimilation.
Here in Columbia, however, we believe that all men are created equal.
Address to the Trimounts Institute of Technology by Loken Williams, founder of Loken Watertank Laboratory

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Composition analysis failed.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Liquid does not match any known compound.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Look.
White crystals form at her fingertips, spreading to cover her entire hand and forearm.
It is a scene that you just saw, and which is as familiar to you from combat reports as from your own experience.
Saria does not answer.
Suddenly, she raises her hand, and you find her fist in front of your nose faster than you can blink.
You hear the sound of mineral impacting metal, and know that Mechanist blocked the attack for you.
Before you can catch your breath, you feel something cold touch your neck.
Saria's other hand never moved.
But there is a calcified blade at your throat, nonetheless.
You instinctively hold your breath.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Explain yourself, Saria.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: This is the quickest way to explain it.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: My Originium Arts reconstruct matter containing calcium, at a molecular level. This is what you call calcification.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I can control the enamel formed this way using my mind, without the need to move.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: No radio signals or programs.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: They are like an extension of my limbs.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Do you mean the power armor—

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: A power armor is nothing more than a power armor.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: This silvery liquid is the key.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: It's the neurotransmitter of the power armor, linking the brainwaves of the operator to the machine.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Like an Arts Unit?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: More than that, I should say.

options: I need to catch my breath...

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Sorry if I've caused any discomfort.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: I would not have gone for the Doctor's hand, were it not for that gesture to me.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Good thing we know each other so well.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: There's someone I want to see.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: As far as I know, he's the first to actually use this prototype power armor.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I would like you to come, with Mechanist.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You saw them go into a bar near the university?

steps.name: Columbian Mercenary
steps.text: Yes, ma'am. All three of them.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I can guess who it is Saria's looking for.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: We just saw him last week.

steps.name: Columbian Mercenary
steps.text: Didn't he agree not to meet anyone from Rhine Lab?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Is Saria still Rhine?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I don't think she knows the answer herself.

steps.name: Columbian Mercenary
steps.text: Should we stop them?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I'm curious how much Saria knows.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: It's about time we had a talk.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: And one more thing... Loken Williams is a graduate of the Trimounts Institute of Technology.

steps.name: Columbian Mercenary
steps.text: Loken Williams...? Who is that?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I guess time really does fly.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: One accident, and everyone forgets the brightest star of academia.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Saria and the Control of Rhine Lab went to the same school.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Social gatherings in Columbia's tech sector are basically all TIT reunions.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I wish I could've spent some time at that school myself.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Let's go. Maybe it's not too late to join the fun.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: The last fire bomb!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Throw it! Far as you can!

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Here goes!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: With me! Get inside!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: We got everybody?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Whew... yes, sir. All present and accounted for.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: What about the monsters?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Not yet. The flask's still burning, looks like it's got their attention.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Thank you, everyone.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: We have all of the injured.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: What's next, Doc Silence?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Sir, the door—

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: It won't open! What the hell is going on?!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You lock that door, Doc?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I've never been to this test site before.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Dr. Urbica?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The lab doors are automatic.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: But it's locked!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Doctor...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What are you complaining about? Aren't you afraid of those silver constructs outside?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: How're we supposed to know if you're trying to keep them out, or keep us in?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Maybe you planned all this!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Are you joking?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Hah! You're saying I somehow made you kidnap me?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Watch it! You're our prisoner, don't forget!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Sam!

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: You're the one who said these whitecoats are fooling us!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: No, be quiet for a sec—

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You hear it, Doc Silence? A rustle, like something slithering on the ground...

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: Do not stop, and do not look back.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: Push open the third door on your right.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: It opened!

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: Do not be afraid. I will protect you.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: As always.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Test results for the latest batch of Transmitter?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: In a laboratory environment, of course...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: A one-point-seven percent increase in efficiency.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: A massive breakthrough in one month.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Excellent work. Do you need more time? Ten days? Twenty?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: S-Sorry! Whoa...
Come now, don't frighten the youths like that.
No wonder the staff so fear the accolades of the Director of Energy.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Come to boast about your people skills, Parvis?

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Just passing through.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Back to your lab now, poor little fellow, I'll keep your director company for a bit.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Er, alright, ok!

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Thank you...

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Ahah! So quick on his feet. Such is youth, eh? Gone in a flash.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I don't see you outside your lab often, except for directors' meetings.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: What brings you here, exactly?

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Where do I even start? The brain doesn't spin so fast at my age.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You were born with white hair, Caprinae.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Haha.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Oh, now I remember. Do you know where Muelsyse is?

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: We made a bet. She wagered ten boxes of black bean tea from hydroponics in Ecological.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: A bet?

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Two days ago, she told me that you were planning to rid Ferdinand Clooney's name of the 'Director' title.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Sonny...?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Why did you stop?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: We can't do this.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Do what?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: We can't follow that voice.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The voice... you mean Director Franks?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Sonny, Director Franks knows this lab better than anyone, better than Elena or myself. She knows where we'll be safe.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: That's why I don't trust her!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Don't you see? She's pulling our strings, guiding every step, drilling into our minds...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: She's walking us right into her cage, and we're going along with it!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Please calm down, Sonny. Getting excited could exacerbate your condition.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Lemme go! Get away from me!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Oof...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Olivia! Are you okay?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: That's enough, Pioneer.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I would have left you outside, if Olivia didn't insist we help you.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Ha, like we wanted to be here with you in the first place.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I don't understand. At all.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Dorothy was so kind to you.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: How's your son, Dirk?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Not so good, Director Franks. The doctor says he needs an operation.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Is it the cost?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Nothing gets past you. I joined the Pioneer Team to try to help my boy. This is my first project.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: We don't have much money. I shouldn't've spent any on Oripathy medicine. If only I knew my son had heart trouble.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: There's no hope for me, but him... he's still so little...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Don't worry, Dirk. I know a way.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Here's the best heart surgeon I know. Take your son and find her.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: The best surgeon? In Trimounts?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Must be awful pricey...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: She's an old classmate of mine. Tell her Dorothy Franks sent you, and she'll give you a discount.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: R-Really?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Don't tell anybody. It'd be bad for her reputation if word got out that she gives discounts.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Won't tell a soul! Cross my heart!

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: I... I gotta go! Thank your friend for me!

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Why are you standing there? The coffee's getting cold.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: So much the better.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It'll hurt less when I spill it on you.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Are you worried about me, or the coffee?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You can smile and plead all you want, but I'm not lending you lunch money.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Looks like it's plain rice for the rest of the month then.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: A director of Rhine Lab, begging for food from a low-level researcher... can you imagine the scandal?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Originium Art Section is the poorest of the five, after all.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I'm not Ferdinand, I don't have sponsors lined up waiting to dress me in gold from head to tail.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: At least the boss has good taste.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Back on topic, it's not like I don't know the classmate you're talking about. She probably couldn't wait to double her fee when she heard your name.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You're willing to pay anything for your Pioneer friends. No wonder people take advantage of you.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Hahah...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Laugh all you want. Not like I can do anything about it.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I'm going back to my lab.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Maybe finishing this experiment will help stuff your wallet a little.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: She did so much for you, and pushed me into keeping it secret.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: How could you do this to her?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Dr. Urbica, you're Dorothy Franks's friend.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You see only what she wants you to see.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You don't know what terrible things she's hiding under the surface.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Director Franks! My boy's surgery went great. The doctor says he'll be out of the hospital by next week!

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Fantastic. Would you like to go home and see him?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: G-Go home? Back to the city?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: B-But I'm Infected. I can't enter a nomadic city on my own...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Unless you have a new contract that pays for the insurance.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: You're looking at a chance, Dirk. One that can change your destiny.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Sign this consent form, and you'll be able to go home.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Of course I...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: No rush. You have twenty-four hours to think about it.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: This isn't a trick, nothing in the fine print.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I've circled the important points. Make sure you understand the risks.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Come find me if you have any questions.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Dirk!

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: S-Sir? What're you doing here? Did you sign up for...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Give me the consent form.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: W-Why? No!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Don't you get it? She's stuffing you into a cage, to experiment on!

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: S-So what?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Director Franks says she's giving me a chance.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: When was the last time we heard the word 'chance'?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: I don't need twenty-four hours.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: I won't wait another minute for a chance to see my boy!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: That's how she got Dirk.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Not just Dirk. Alan, Gale, Sophia...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: She knew everyone's weaknesses. No one could say no to her.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: That's Dorothy Franks!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Those silver creatures were her...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The silver constructs?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: They're... *cough* *cough*... you know nothing!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: How much do the two of you know about our pursuers?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: One of you calls them creatures, the other uses the word constructs.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm certain I heard correctly. My people are renowned among Liberi for our sense of hearing.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I'm just guessing.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Same here.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: At least you agree on something.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Never mind that. No matter what you think of Dorothy, at this moment, she's helping us escape.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Let's follow her instructions for now.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Maybe our pursuers on the other end of the corridor will help you collect your thoughts.
